tools.name: search_ablo_docs
tools.title: Search @abloatai/ablo Docs
tools.description: Search @abloatai/ablo documentation by keyword. Returns ranked matches with excerpts. Follow up with `get_recipe` on the top hit for the full content.

query.description: The search phrase. Matched case-insensitively against every doc title + body.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5, max 20).

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.title: Get @abloatai/ablo Recipe
tools.description: Return the full markdown content of a single @abloatai/ablo doc. Use this after `search_ablo_docs` identifies the right file, or directly when you know the recipe name. Common names: readme, quickstart, integration-guide, guarantees, client-behavior, data-sources, examples/existing-python-backend, api, examples/ai-sdk-tool, examples/server-agent, agents, llms.

name.description: Recipe / doc file name without the .md extension.

tools.name: get_api_surface
tools.title: Get @abloatai/ablo API Surface
tools.description: Return the structured export list for a @abloatai/ablo subpath. Pass no argument to list every subpath. Use this to discover what exists before writing integration code.

subpath.description: Subpath to inspect (e.g. "@abloatai/ablo"). Omit to list every subpath. Accepts short form: "react", "schema", "testing".

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.title: Validate @abloatai/ablo Schema
tools.description: Lint a user's `defineSchema` code against the DSL rules (camelCase fields, groups sync routing, legacy builders, load strategies). Returns a structured issue list. Call this BEFORE writing the schema file — fixes here are cheaper than fixes after the user runs the app.

code.description: The TypeScript source of the schema file (or just the defineSchema block).

tools.name: scaffold_app
tools.title: Scaffold @abloatai/ablo App
tools.description: Emit a starter file tree for a schema-first @abloatai/ablo integration. Pick `next` for a route handler, `node-agent` for a backend worker, or `plain` for framework-agnostic usage.

appName.description: Display name for the starter. Used in README + package.json.

modelName.description: Model name (lowercase, plural). Used throughout the starter files.

storage.description: How Ablo reaches your Postgres. `direct` (default): set DATABASE_URL and run `ablo migrate` to provision your model tables in your OWN Postgres. `endpoint`: keep DB credentials in your backend and expose a Data Source endpoint Ablo calls (Ablo never sees DATABASE_URL). There is no Ablo-hosted-rows option — you always bring a Postgres.
